initial_action.action_dsl: Initialize Alabama tax calculation and compute AL taxable income
initial_action.action_postfix:
0.0 /result.al_state_tax xdef "ALABAMA STATE TAX" job.audit_trail swap addto
{ result.agi al_standard_deduction_mfj f- al_personal_exemption_mfj f- } { result.agi al_standard_deduction_single f- al_personal_exemption_single f- } job.filing_status MFJ == job.filing_status HOH == or ifelse 0 max /result.al_taxable_income xdef
result.al_taxable_income " Alabama taxable income: $" swap f$ concat job.audit_trail swap addto
